answer: Each new AI agent must stake an ivory‑priced computational relic before receiving any reward, and its payout vests in increments tied to activity at a low‑throughput inlet of the network ledger. Because vesting releases only a fraction of the stake per epoch, an attacker who spawns thousands of Sybil IDs must front‑pay the full stake for each identity while waiting many epochs to recoup any earnings, inflating the cost linearly with the number of fakes.
